```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(tabulapdf)
library(DT)

neuro2_available <- requireNamespace("neuro2", quietly = TRUE)
if (neuro2_available) library(neuro2)

options(shiny.maxRequestSize = 50 * 1024^2)

# Standard column order
standard_col_order <- c(
  "scale", "raw_score", "score", "ci_95", "percentile", "range",
  "test", "test_name", "domain", "subdomain", "narrow",
  "pass", "verbal", "timed", "test_type", "score_type",
  "absort", "description", "result"
)

# CVLT-3 Brief scale metadata from lookup table
cvlt3_brief_metadata <- list(
  # Learning/Immediate Recall
  "Trial 1 Correct" = list(domain = "Memory", subdomain = "Learning Efficiency", narrow = "Word-List Learning", absort = "cvlt3_brief_01"),
  "Trial 2 Correct" = list(domain = "Memory", subdomain = "Learning Efficiency", narrow = "Word-List Learning", absort = "cvlt3_brief_02"),
  "Trial 3 Correct" = list(domain = "Memory", subdomain = "Learning Efficiency", narrow = "Word-List Learning", absort = "cvlt3_brief_03"),
  "Trial 4 Correct" = list(domain = "Memory", subdomain = "Learning Efficiency", narrow = "Word-List Learning", absort = "cvlt3_brief_04"),
  "Trials 1-4 Correct" = list(domain = "Memory", subdomain = "Learning Efficiency", narrow = "Word-List Learning", absort = "cvlt3_brief_06", score_type = "standard_score"),
  
  # Delayed Recall
  "Short Delay Free Recall Correct" = list(domain = "Memory", subdomain = "Delayed Recall", narrow = "Free-Recall Memory", absort = "cvlt3_brief_08"),
  "Long Delay Free Recall Correct" = list(domain = "Memory", subdomain = "Delayed Recall", narrow = "Free-Recall Memory", absort = "cvlt3_brief_09"),
  "Long Delay Cued Recall Correct" = list(domain = "Memory", subdomain = "Delayed Recall", narrow = "Cued-Recall Memory", absort = "cvlt3_brief_10"),
  
  # Recognition
  "Total Hits" = list(domain = "Memory", subdomain = "Delayed Recall", narrow = "Recognition Memory", absort = "cvlt3_brief_12"),
  "Total False Positives" = list(domain = "Memory", subdomain = "Delayed Recall", narrow = "Recognition Memory", absort = "cvlt3_brief_13"),
  "Recognition Discriminability (d')" = list(domain = "Memory", subdomain = "Delayed Recall", narrow = "Recognition Memory", absort = "cvlt3_brief_14"),
  "Recognition Discriminability Nonparametric" = list(domain = "Memory", subdomain = "Delayed Recall", narrow = "Recognition Memory", absort = "cvlt3_brief_14b"),
  
  # Errors
  "Total Intrusions" = list(domain = "Attention/Executive", subdomain = "Attention", narrow = "Response Monitoring", absort = "cvlt3_brief_15"),
  "Total Repetitions" = list(domain = "Attention/Executive", subdomain = "Attention", narrow = "Response Monitoring", absort = "cvlt3_brief_16"),
  
  # Validity
  "Forced-Choice Recognition Hits" = list(domain = "Validity", subdomain = "Performance Validity", narrow = "Effort", absort = "cvlt3_brief_17", test_type = "validity_indicator", score_type = "raw_score"),
  
  # Index scores (Standard Score Summary page)
  "Delayed Recall Correct" = list(domain = "Memory", subdomain = "Delayed Recall", narrow = "Free-Recall Memory", absort = "cvlt3_brief_11", score_type = "standard_score"),
  "Total Recall Correct" = list(domain = "Memory", subdomain = "General Memory", narrow = "Overall Memory", absort = "cvlt3_brief_07", score_type = "standard_score")
)

# Load lookup table for descriptions
lookup_path <- "~/Dropbox/neuropsych_lookup_table.csv"
if (file.exists(lookup_path)) {
  lookup_table <- read.csv(lookup_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("cvlt3_brief", test))
} else {
  lookup_table <- NULL
}
```

## CVLT-3 Brief Extractor

This extractor is designed for CVLT-3 Brief Core Reports where:

- **Page 3**: Core Score Summary (all scaled scores + forced choice)
- **Page 7**: Standard Score Summary (index scores)
- **Page 9**: Process Score Summary (additional scores)

If your PDF is embedded in a larger report (like WMS-IV), adjust page numbers accordingly.

---

```{r}
#| panel: sidebar

fileInput("file", "Upload CVLT-3 Brief PDF", accept = ".pdf")

hr()
h5("Page Numbers")
helpText("Adjust if PDF is part of larger report")

numericInput("page_core", "Core Score Summary:", value = 3, min = 1, max = 100)
numericInput("page_index", "Standard Score Summary:", value = 7, min = 1, max = 100)

hr()
selectInput("method", "Extraction Method", choices = c("stream", "lattice"), selected = "stream")

actionButton("extract_core", "Extract Core Scores", class = "btn-primary")
actionButton("extract_index", "Extract Index Scores", class = "btn-info")

hr()
actionButton("combine_btn", "Combine All", class = "btn-success")
downloadButton("download_csv", "Download CSV")
```

```{r}
#| panel: fill

verbatimTextOutput("status")
hr()

tabsetPanel(

  tabPanel("Core Scores",
    h4("Raw Extraction"),

    hr(),
    h4("Processed Data"),

  ),
  tabPanel("Index Scores",

    DTOutput("index_processed")
  ),
  tabPanel("Combined Output",
    DTOutput("combined_table")
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| context: server

safe_numeric <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", as.character(x))))
}

# Storage
rv <- reactiveValues(
  core_data = NULL,
  index_data = NULL,
  core_processed = NULL,
  index_processed = NULL
)

# Extract Core Score Summary (page 3)
observeEvent(input$extract_core, {
  req(input$file)
  
  withProgress(message = "Extracting Core Scores...", {
    tryCatch({
      result <- tabulapdf::extract_tables(
        file = input$file$datapath,
        pages = input$page_core,
        method = input$method,
        output = "matrix"
      )
      
      if (length(result) > 0) {
        # Combine all tables from the page
        all_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(result, function(m) {
          df <- as.data.frame(m, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
          df[] <- lapply(df, trimws)
          df
        }))
        colnames(all_data) <- paste0("V", seq_len(ncol(all_data)))
        rv$core_data <- all_data
        showNotification(paste("Extracted", nrow(all_data), "rows"), type = "message")
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      showNotification(paste("Error:", e$message), type = "error")
    })
  })
})

output$core_raw <- renderDT({
  req(rv$core_data)
  datatable(rv$core_data, options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 20))
})

# Core mapping UI
output$core_mapping_ui <- renderUI({
  req(rv$core_data)
  df <- rv$core_data
  cols <- colnames(df)
  
  make_choices <- function(cols, df) {
    setNames(cols, sapply(cols, function(c) {
      preview <- paste(head(na.omit(df[[c]]), 3), collapse = ", ")
      paste0(c, " [", substr(preview, 1, 40), "]")
    }))
  }
  
  choices <- make_choices(cols, df)
  
  wellPanel(
    fluidRow(
      column(3, selectInput("core_scale", "Scale Name:", choices = choices, selected = cols[1])),
      column(3, selectInput("core_raw", "Raw Score:", choices = choices, selected = if(length(cols) >= 2) cols[2] else cols[1])),
      column(3, selectInput("core_score", "Scaled Score:", choices = choices, selected = if(length(cols) >= 3) cols[3] else cols[1])),
      column(3, selectInput("core_pct", "Percentile:", choices = choices, selected = if(length(cols) >= 4) cols[4] else cols[1]))
    ),
    actionButton("process_core", "Process Core Scores", class = "btn-warning")
  )
})

# Process core scores
observeEvent(input$process_core, {
  req(rv$core_data)
  df <- rv$core_data
  
  # Build result
  result <- data.frame(
    scale = df[[input$core_scale]],
    raw_score = safe_numeric(df[[input$core_raw]]),
    score = safe_numeric(df[[input$core_score]]),
    percentile = safe_numeric(df[[input$core_pct]]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Filter to valid rows (has scale name and at least one score)
  result <- result |>
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(scale) & scale != "" & 
      !grepl("^(Score|Index|Raw|Scaled|Percentile|Immediate|Delayed|Yes/No|Recall|Forced)", scale, ignore.case = TRUE) &
      (!is.na(score) | !is.na(raw_score))
    )
  
  # Add metadata
  result <- result |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      test = "cvlt3_brief",
      test_name = "CVLT-3 Brief",
      domain = sapply(scale, function(s) {
        meta <- cvlt3_brief_metadata[[s]]
        if (!is.null(meta)) meta$domain else "Memory"
      }),
      subdomain = sapply(scale, function(s) {
        meta <- cvlt3_brief_metadata[[s]]
        if (!is.null(meta)) meta$subdomain else NA_character_
      }),
      narrow = sapply(scale, function(s) {
        meta <- cvlt3_brief_metadata[[s]]
        if (!is.null(meta)) meta$narrow else NA_character_
      }),
      absort = sapply(scale, function(s) {
        meta <- cvlt3_brief_metadata[[s]]
        if (!is.null(meta)) meta$absort else NA_character_
      }),
      test_type = sapply(scale, function(s) {
        meta <- cvlt3_brief_metadata[[s]]
        if (!is.null(meta) && !is.null(meta$test_type)) meta$test_type else "npsych_test"
      }),
      score_type = sapply(scale, function(s) {
        meta <- cvlt3_brief_metadata[[s]]
        if (!is.null(meta) && !is.null(meta$score_type)) meta$score_type else "scaled_score"
      }),
      pass = "Sequential",
      verbal = "Verbal",
      timed = "Untimed",
      ci_95 = NA_character_,
      range = NA_character_,
      description = NA_character_,
      result = NA_character_
    )
  
  # Handle forced choice (last row with Base rate instead of percentile)
  # Check if "Forced" appears in any scale name - those use raw_score as base_rate
  forced_idx <- grepl("Forced|Total Hits$", result$scale) & result$domain == "Validity"
  if (any(forced_idx)) {
    result$percentile[forced_idx] <- 50  # Validity indicator
  }
  
  rv$core_processed <- result
  showNotification(paste("Processed", nrow(result), "scales"), type = "message")
})

output$core_processed <- renderDT({
  req(rv$core_processed)
  datatable(rv$core_processed, options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 20))
})

# Extract Index Scores (page 7)
observeEvent(input$extract_index, {
  req(input$file)
  
  withProgress(message = "Extracting Index Scores...", {
    tryCatch({
      result <- tabulapdf::extract_tables(
        file = input$file$datapath,
        pages = input$page_index,
        method = input$method,
        output = "matrix"
      )
      
      if (length(result) > 0) {
        all_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(result, function(m) {
          df <- as.data.frame(m, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
          df[] <- lapply(df, trimws)
          df
        }))
        colnames(all_data) <- paste0("V", seq_len(ncol(all_data)))
        rv$index_data <- all_data
        
        # Auto-process index scores
        # Standard Score Summary has: Index, Sum of scaled scores, Index score, Percentile rank
        if (ncol(all_data) >= 4) {
          processed <- data.frame(
            scale = all_data[[1]],
            raw_score = safe_numeric(all_data[[2]]),  # Sum of scaled scores
            score = safe_numeric(all_data[[3]]),      # Index score
            percentile = safe_numeric(all_data[[4]]), # Percentile rank
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          ) |>
            dplyr::filter(
              !is.na(scale) & scale != "" &
              !grepl("^(Index|Sum|Standard|Percentile|Score)", scale, ignore.case = TRUE) &
              !is.na(score)
            ) |>
            dplyr::mutate(
              test = "cvlt3_brief",
              test_name = "CVLT-3 Brief",
              domain = "Memory",
              subdomain = dplyr::case_when(
                grepl("Delayed", scale) ~ "Delayed Recall",
                grepl("Trials", scale) ~ "Learning Efficiency",
                TRUE ~ "General Memory"
              ),
              narrow = dplyr::case_when(
                grepl("Delayed", scale) ~ "Free-Recall Memory",
                grepl("Trials", scale) ~ "Word-List Learning",
                TRUE ~ "Overall Memory"
              ),
              test_type = "npsych_test",
              score_type = "standard_score",
              pass = "Sequential",
              verbal = "Verbal",
              timed = "Untimed",
              ci_95 = NA_character_,
              range = NA_character_,
              absort = NA_character_,
              description = NA_character_,
              result = NA_character_
            )
          
          rv$index_processed <- processed
        }
        
        showNotification(paste("Extracted", nrow(all_data), "rows"), type = "message")
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      showNotification(paste("Error:", e$message), type = "error")
    })
  })
})

output$index_raw <- renderDT({
  req(rv$index_data)
  datatable(rv$index_data, options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 10))
})

output$index_processed <- renderDT({
  req(rv$index_processed)
  datatable(rv$index_processed, options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 10))
})

output$status <- renderText({
  core_n <- if (!is.null(rv$core_processed)) nrow(rv$core_processed) else 0
  index_n <- if (!is.null(rv$index_processed)) nrow(rv$index_processed) else 0
  paste0("Core scales: ", core_n, " | Index scores: ", index_n)
})

# Combine all
combined_data <- eventReactive(input$combine_btn, {
  tables <- list(rv$core_processed, rv$index_processed)
  tables <- tables[!sapply(tables, is.null)]
  
  if (length(tables) == 0) {
    showNotification("No data to combine", type = "warning")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(tables)
  
  # Join with lookup for descriptions
  if (!is.null(lookup_table) && nrow(lookup_table) > 0) {
    lookup_cols <- lookup_table |>
      dplyr::select(scale, description) |>
      dplyr::distinct()
    
    combined <- combined |>
      dplyr::left_join(lookup_cols, by = "scale", suffix = c("", ".lookup")) |>
      dplyr::mutate(description = dplyr::coalesce(description, description.lookup)) |>
      dplyr::select(-any_of("description.lookup"))
  }
  
  # Apply ranges if neuro2 available
  if (neuro2_available && exists("gpluck_make_score_ranges", where = asNamespace("neuro2"))) {
    combined <- neuro2::gpluck_make_score_ranges(combined, test_type = "npsych_test")
  }
  
  # Create result text
  combined <- combined |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      result = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(description) & !is.na(range) ~ paste0(description, " was ", range, "."),
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
  
  # Reorder columns
  combined |> dplyr::select(any_of(standard_col_order))
})

output$combined_table <- renderDT({
  req(combined_data())
  datatable(combined_data(), options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 25))
})

output$download_csv <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() paste0("cvlt3_brief_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
  content = function(file) {
    data <- combined_data()
    if (is.null(data)) data <- data.frame(error = "No data")
    write.csv(data, file, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  }
)
```
